name: Ongoing Directive

talents.name: Rules of Engagement
talents.text: Shooting an enemy that has a status effect marks it for 10 seconds. Killing a marked enemy gives your active weapon a full magazine of Hollow-Point Ammo and gives the rest of the group a half magazine. Hollow-Point Ammo grants +40% Weapon Damage and applies Bleed.

talents.name: Parabellum Rounds
talents.text: Increases the Hollow-Point Ammo Weapon Damage bonus from 40% to 60%. Applies to you only, not to the group.

talents.name: Trauma Specialist
talents.text: Increases the duration of Bleed applied by Hollow-Point Ammo by 50% and its Bleed damage by 100%.

notes: Y8S3 (PTS, matches Grindout): Hollow-Point Ammo 20% -> 40%, Parabellum Rounds 50% -> 60%.
NamuWiki and Grindout agree on the 2pc/3pc; the Y8S3 talent values come from AllThings.how (PTS) and Grindout, not from the final Ubisoft notes, which name no numbers.

name: Hard Wired

talents.name: Feedback Loop
talents.text: Using or cancelling a skill reduces the cooldown of your other skill by 30 seconds and grants +10% Skill Damage and +10% Repair Skills for 20 seconds. Can trigger once every 10 seconds.

talents.name: Positive Reinforcement
talents.text: Increases the Feedback Loop Skill Damage and Repair Skills bonus from +10% to +25%.

talents.name: Short Circuit
talents.text: Reduces the Feedback Loop trigger cooldown from 10 seconds to 5 seconds.

notes: Conflict on the Feedback Loop trigger cooldown: Fandom wiki and NamuWiki give 10 s base and Short Circuit 10 s -> 5 s; Grindout and older guides give 20 s base and Short Circuit 20 s -> 10 s. The newer wiki values are used.
The dossier noted that the Steam guide swaps the chest and backpack names; Fandom, Grindout and two other sources agree on Positive Reinforcement = chest, Short Circuit = backpack.

name: True Patriot

talents.name: Red, White and Blue
talents.text: Every 2 seconds, enemies you shoot receive the next debuff in the cycle. Red: they take +15% damage. White: shooting them repairs 2% of your armor once per second. Blue: they deal -10% damage. An enemy that dies while carrying all three debuffs explodes in a 5 m radius for damage equal to its health plus armor (reduced against named enemies).

talents.name: Waving the Flag
talents.text: The debuff cycle rotates every 1 second instead of every 2 seconds.

talents.name: Patriotic Boost
talents.text: Increases the debuff strengths: Red from 15% to 30%, White from 2% to 5%, Blue from 10% to 20%.

notes: Y8S3 changes (AllThings.how PTS, Fandom, Grindout agree): 2pc Ammo Capacity 30% -> Weapon Handling 15%; Red 8% -> 15%; Blue 8% -> 10%; Waving the Flag 1.5 s -> 1 s; Patriotic Boost now 30/5/20%.
Fandom's gear set list page still shows the pre-Y8S3 numbers (8/2/8, Patriotic Boost 12/3/12).

name: Aces & Eights

talents.name: Dead Man's Hand
talents.text: Hitting an enemy with a Marksman Rifle reveals a card; headshots reveal an additional card. Once five cards are revealed, the hand is evaluated and your next shots deal +75% damage: Four of a Kind amplifies the next 4 shots, Full House the next 3, Aces and Eights the next 2.

talents.name: No Limit
talents.text: Increases the Dead Man's Hand damage bonus from 75% to 100%.

talents.name: Ace in the Sleeve
talents.text: Adds 1 additional amplified shot when your hand is revealed.

notes: Y8S3 (AllThings.how PTS, Grindout): 2pc 15% -> 30%, Dead Man's Hand 30% -> 75%, No Limit 50% -> 100%. Ubisoft's Y8S3 PTS notes confirm only that Aces & Eights was buffed, without numbers.
Introduction day is not confirmed: TU3 went live 2019-05-14 and the raid Operation Dark Hours opened 2019-05-16; PCGamesN places the three sets after the raid. Month only.

name: Tip of the Spear

talents.name: Aggressive Recon
talents.text: Killing an enemy with your Signature Weapon grants +15% Signature Weapon Damage for 10 seconds and +25% Reload Speed on your next reload (does not stack). Every 60 seconds you automatically receive Signature Weapon ammo.

talents.name: Specialized Destruction
talents.text: Increases the Signature Weapon Damage bonus from 15% to 30%. Every 3rd Signature Weapon kill generates Signature Weapon ammo.

talents.name: Signature Moves
talents.text: Gain +50% Weapon Damage for 15 seconds when your Signature Weapon runs empty. Doubles the ammo generated by Aggressive Recon.

notes: Introduction day not confirmed (see Aces & Eights); month only.

name: Negotiator's Dilemma

talents.name: Crowd Control
talents.text: Critical hits mark enemies for 20 seconds, up to 3 marks. Critical hits against a marked enemy pass 60% of the damage dealt to all other marked enemies. Every time a marked enemy dies you gain +10% Critical Hit Damage, up to 10 stacks, until combat ends.

talents.name: Target Rich Environment
talents.text: Increases the number of marks from 3 to 5.

talents.name: Critical Measures
talents.text: Increases the damage passed to the other marked enemies from 60% to 100%.

notes: 4pc talent name: ProtoTrack, the AllThings.how Y8S3 PTS table and ImmortalBoost say Crowd Control; Grindout and one Fandom page say Hostile Negotiations (the dossier used the latter). Crowd Control is used; the trigger text is identical.

Chest/backpack assignment: Grindout and ImmortalBoost put the mark count on the chest and the damage share on the backpack; Kingboost/LFCarry reverse the names (Critical Measures on the chest). Dossier assignment kept.
Backpack value: 100% (Grindout, ImmortalBoost, newer Fandom page) versus 112% (NamuWiki, older Fandom page). 100% used.
Y8S3 (AllThings.how PTS): Critical Hit Damage on kill 2% (20 stacks) -> 10% (10 stacks).
Introduction day not confirmed (see Aces & Eights); month only.

name: Striker's Battlegear

talents.name: Striker's Gamble
talents.text: Each weapon hit grants +0.65% Weapon Damage, up to 100 stacks. You lose 1 stack per second while at 50 stacks or fewer and 2 stacks per second between 50 and 100 stacks.

talents.name: Press the Advantage
talents.text: Increases the maximum stacks of Striker's Gamble from 100 to 200. Between 100 and 200 stacks you lose 3 stacks per second.

talents.name: Risk Management
talents.text: Increases the Weapon Damage gained per stack of Striker's Gamble from 0.65% to 0.9%.

notes: Resolved dispute: Risk Management was 1% from TU16 and was lowered to 0.9% in Y6S2 (Y6S2 PTS phase 2 notes, mirrored on r/thedivision). Skycoach and NamuWiki give 0.9%; Grindout and one Fandom page still show the old 1%.
Added to the Division 2 with Warlords of New York (TU8, released 2020-03-03); single source for the set assignment (NamuWiki).

name: System Corruption

talents.name: Hackstep Protocol
talents.text: Replaces Armor Kits with an ability that has unlimited uses and a 20 second cooldown: it repairs 20% of your armor, grants 50% Bonus Armor and hides your nameplate for 5 seconds. For every 5% Bonus Armor received you gain +2% Weapon Damage, up to +20%.

talents.name: Compiler Optimization
talents.text: Reduces the Hackstep Protocol cooldown from 20 seconds to 15 seconds.

talents.name: Multithreaded Execution
talents.text: Increases the Bonus Armor granted by Hackstep Protocol from 50% to 100%.

notes: Added with Warlords of New York (TU8, 2020-03-03); single source for the set assignment (NamuWiki).

name: Eclipse Protocol

talents.name: Indirect Transmission
talents.text: When an enemy dies, its status effects spread to enemies within 10 m and refresh 50% of their duration.

talents.name: Proliferation
talents.text: Increases the spread range from 10 m to 15 m and the duration refresh from 50% to 75%.

talents.name: Symptom Aggravator
talents.text: Deal +30% damage to targets affected by a status effect.

notes: Date: Season 2 Keener's Legacy started 2020-06-23 (TU10 itself shipped 2020-06-16 as update 1.24); GameSpot lists Eclipse Protocol under Season 2. The dossier only had 'June 2020'.
Original TU10 values were 15 m spread and 20 m chest range; current Grindout and Skycoach agree on 10 m -> 15 m.

name: Foundry Bulwark

talents.name: Makeshift Repairs
talents.text: Whenever you or your shield take damage, 25% of that damage is repaired over 10 seconds on both you and your shield.

talents.name: Process Refinery
talents.text: Increases the Makeshift Repairs repair amount from 25% to 35%.

talents.name: Improved Materials
talents.text: Reduces the Makeshift Repairs repair time from 10 seconds to 5 seconds.

notes: Values 25% / 10 s, chest 25% -> 35%, backpack 10 s -> 5 s come from the Title Update 20 PTS notes (mp1st) and Grindout; the original TU10 values were 20% / 15 s with chest 20% -> 30%. A Steam guide (2026-04) and the main Fandom page still show 20-25% / 15 s.

Talent names and slots conflict: TU20 PTS notes define Process Refinery = amount (25% -> 35%) and Improved Materials = time (10 s -> 5 s). The TU10-era GameSpot text puts Process Refinery on the chest; the Fandom TU20 page puts Improved Materials (time) on the chest. The dossier had the names the other way round (chest Improved Materials, backpack Process Refinery).
3pc Armor Regeneration changed from 3% to 1% and Shield Health +50% was added in TU10.1 (2020-07-21).
Date: Operation Iron Horse level 40 raid 2020-06-30 (the sets drop from it); TU10 itself was 2020-06-16.

name: Future Initiative

talents.name: Ground Control
talents.text: While your armor is full, you and your allies gain +15% Weapon Damage and +15% Skill Damage. When you repair an ally, you and allies within 5 m are repaired for 60% of that amount.

talents.name: Tactical Superiority
talents.text: Increases the Ground Control damage bonus from 15% to 25%.

talents.name: Strategic Combat Support
talents.text: Increases the Ground Control proximity repair from 60% to 120%.

notes: Backpack name: Fandom set page and gear list say Strategic Combat Support; Skycoach and the Fandom TU10 page say Advanced Combat Tactics. Strategic Combat Support used.
Date: Operation Iron Horse level 40 raid 2020-06-30; TU10 itself was 2020-06-16.

talents.name: Apex Predator
talents.text: Enemies within 15 m are debuffed and take +20% Weapon Damage from you. Killing a debuffed enemy disorients enemies within 5 m and grants +5% Weapon Damage for 10 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

talents.name: Endless Hunger
talents.text: Increases the stack duration from 10 seconds to 30 seconds.

talents.name: Overwhelming Force
talents.text: Increases the disorient radius from 5 m to 10 m.

talents.name: Tend and Befriend
talents.text: Interacting with a placed skill (placing it, switching its target or healing with it) grants +25% Skill Damage for 10 seconds. Cannot be refreshed while active.

talents.name: Best Buds
talents.text: Increases the Skill Damage bonus from 25% to 50%.

talents.name: Complete Uptime
talents.text: Cancelling a skill resets its cooldown.

name: Heartbreaker

talents.name: Heartstopper
talents.text: Headshots apply Pulse to the enemy for 5 seconds. Weapon hits on pulsed enemies grant a stack of +1% Bonus Armor and +1% Weapon Damage, up to 50 stacks. You lose 2 stacks per second.

talents.name: Max BPM
talents.text: Increases the maximum stacks of Heartstopper from 50 to 100.

talents.name: Cold
talents.text: Increases the Bonus Armor gained per stack from 1% to 2%.

notes: One source (NamuWiki, per the dossier) shows 1.1% damage per stack; Fandom and Grindout show 1%. 1% used.

talents.name: From the Shadows / Into the Light
talents.text: From the Shadows: while in cover you gain 10 stacks per second, up to 50; each stack gives +1% Critical Hit Damage and +0.3% Rate of Fire. Out of cover you lose 2 stacks per second (1 per second while sprinting). Into the Light: while out of cover and in combat you gain 10 stacks per second, up to 50; each stack gives +0.8% Armor Regeneration. In cover you lose 10 stacks per second.

talents.name: From the Shadows
talents.text: Increases the maximum From the Shadows stacks from 50 to 100 and the stack gain from 10 to 20 per second.

talents.name: Into the Light
talents.text: Increases the maximum Into the Light stacks from 50 to 100 and the stack gain and consumption from 10 to 20 per second.

name: Hotshot

talents.name: Headache
talents.text: Consecutive Marksman Rifle headshots build a chain. The 1st headshot amplifies your next headshot by 80%. The 2nd grants +10% Armor (as Bonus Armor while armor is full, up to +50%). The 3rd refills your magazine. From the 4th headshot on, all three bonuses apply with every headshot. A miss resets the chain.

talents.name: Daring
talents.text: Increases the maximum Bonus Armor from Headache from 50% to 100%.

talents.name: Blessed
talents.text: Allows one miss before the Headache chain is reset.

notes: Y8S3 (AllThings.how PTS, Grindout): first-headshot bonus 20% -> 80%; the +30% Weapon Handling moved from the 2pc to the 3pc. Ubisoft's Y8S3 PTS notes only say Hotshot was buffed.

name: Cavalier

talents.name: Charging / Charged
talents.text: Each second you spend out of cover in combat reduces incoming skill damage by 5%, up to 50%. When fully charged you are immune to movement-speed debuffs, and for 10 seconds you share your Hazard Protection and damage reduction with allies. Afterwards the charge starts over.

talents.name: Overcharging
talents.text: Increases the maximum Charging damage protection from 50% to 70%.

talents.name: Safe Charging
talents.text: Charging grants 10% protection per second instead of 5%.

notes: Launch values (TU18, 2023-06) were Charging 5% per second up to 40% and Overcharging 50%; Sportskeeda, ImmortalBoost, Grindout and the current Fandom page give 50% / 70% now. The patch that raised them was not identified.
The 3pc was 'Incoming Repairs' at launch; current sources call it Repair Skills (Y8S3 removed the Incoming Repairs bonus from the Brand Set pool).
Date: servers went down 2023-06-08 for the Y5S1 / TU18 rollout; Ubisoft's launch article is dated 2023-06-09.

name: Ortiz: Exuro

talents.name: Ortiz Incinerator Turret Prototype
talents.text: The Incinerator Turret rotates 360 degrees. You are immune to its fire. When the turret is destroyed or disabled it explodes.

talents.name: Chain Combustion
talents.text: Enemies ignited by the turret ignite other enemies within 10 m.

talents.name: Heatstroke
talents.text: Deal +40% Weapon Damage to enemies ignited by the turret. Increases the turret range by 25%.

notes: Y8S3 (AllThings.how PTS, Grindout): Chain Combustion range 2 m -> 10 m; Heatstroke 25% -> 40%. AllThings notes Heatstroke is an amplifier although the in-game text says weapon damage.

name: Aegis

talents.name: Stoic
talents.text: Gain +3% Damage Resistance for each enemy that targets you, multiplied by 1.X where X is the number of Agents in your group.

talents.name: Deceit
talents.text: Enemies that target your Decoy count towards Stoic.

talents.name: Polyethylene Plating
talents.text: Increases the Damage Resistance per targeting enemy from 3% to 4%.

notes: 2pc Health is a flat value (+70 Health) in Ubisoft's Y5S3 article, shown as +70% in Grindout/ProtoTrack; the percentage form is kept as in the current sources.

name: Breaking Point

talents.name: On Point
talents.text: Hitting a shot with a Rifle or Marksman Rifle grants a stack (up to the weapon's magazine size). Reloading grants +2% Weapon Handling and +4% Weapon Damage per stack for 20 seconds; no new stacks build while the effect is active. When the timer runs out your magazine is refilled. Switching weapons ends the effect and clears the stacks.

talents.name: Point of No Return
talents.text: Increases the On Point duration from 20 seconds to 40 seconds.

talents.name: Point of Honor
talents.text: Increases the Weapon Damage per On Point stack from 4% to 9%.

notes: Resolved: On Point is +2% Weapon Handling and +4% Weapon Damage per stack (Grindout, Skycoach, MP1st Y6S1, current Fandom page); the 2% weapon damage in Grindout's table is an error.

Backpack 4% -> 9% is given by the current Fandom Breaking Point page and Grindout; pre-Y8S3 sources (Y6S1 notes, Steam guide, Fandom list page) show 4% -> 6%, and the AllThings.how PTS table does not list the backpack. 9% used as the post-Y8S3 value.
3pc Weapon Handling is 30% after Y8S3 (15% before; ProtoTrack and Fandom agree on 30%).
Y8S3 (AllThings.how PTS): 2pc 25% -> 30%; On Point 10 s -> 20 s; Point of No Return 15 s -> 40 s.

talents.name: Symphony
talents.text: Killing an enemy beyond 25 m grants, for 15 seconds, +40% damage with Shotguns, SMGs and Pistols, +20% with Assault Rifles and LMGs, and 25% Bonus Armor. Killing an enemy within 25 m grants, for 15 seconds, +40% damage with Marksman Rifles and Rifles, +20% with Assault Rifles and LMGs, and +30% Headshot Damage. Kills at both distances build stacks; at 4 stacks both bonuses apply at the same time, multiplied by 1.5, for 15 seconds.

talents.name: Fortissimo
talents.text: Doubles the Weapon Damage bonuses of Symphony.

talents.name: Accelerando
talents.text: Reduces the stacks required for the combined Symphony bonus from 4 to 3.

name: Refactor

talents.name: Return to Sender
talents.text: You are repaired for 10% of the damage your skills deal, and your allies for 20%.

talents.name: Increased Interest
talents.text: Increases the repair from your skill damage from 10% to 25% for you and from 20% to 35% for allies.

talents.name: Over-engineered
talents.text: While your armor is full, repairs from Return to Sender are converted to Bonus Armor, up to 80% of your Total Armor. Does not apply to allies.

notes: Resolved: 3pc is +25% Skill Damage (Ubisoft Y6S3, Grindout, ProtoTrack, Fandom); the Steam guide's 15% is outdated or PvP.

Ubisoft's Y6S3 article lists the chest as 'PvE 5% -> 15% / 10% -> 20%, PvP 10% -> 25% / 20% -> 35%', but its base values are PvE 10%/20% and PvP 5%/10%, so the PvE/PvP labels in that article are swapped. PvE chest is 10% -> 25% and 20% -> 35% (Grindout, current Fandom Refactor page).
Date: season launched 2025-02-25 (Ubisoft article dated 2025-02-24 announces it).

name: Measured Assembly

talents.name: Huddle
talents.text: Gain +1 Skill Tier for each ally Agent within range of your Hive. At Skill Tier 6, if an ally stays within range of your Hive or Smart Cover for 4 seconds, you gain Overcharge for 15 seconds (40 second cooldown). Mortars and enemy skills entering that range are destroyed (10 second cooldown, 20% faster per ally in range).

talents.name: Hivemind
talents.text: Reduces the Overcharge cooldown from 40 seconds to 25 seconds.

talents.name: Smart Cooperation
talents.text: Reduces the cooldown for destroying mortars and enemy skills from 10 seconds to 1 second.

notes: Date: Ubisoft's Crossroads article is dated 2025-05-26 (maintenance); the season and the Battle for Brooklyn DLC went live 2025-05-27.

name: Tipping Scales

talents.name: Throttle Control
talents.text: Firing your weapon builds up to 50 stacks, each giving +0.5% Weapon Handling and +5% Critical Hit Damage. While you are not shooting you lose 6 stacks per second, unless an enemy is suppressed.

talents.name: Sustainability
talents.text: Increases the maximum stacks from 50 to 75.

talents.name: Snowball
talents.text: Increases the Critical Hit Damage per stack from 5% to 8%.

notes: Y8S3 (AllThings.how PTS): Critical Hit Damage per stack 4% -> 5%; Snowball 4% -> 7% became 5% -> 8% (AllThings.how).

name: Concentrated Company

talents.name: Camaraderie
talents.text: Shooting an enemy marks it for 10 seconds (up to 4 marks). When a marked enemy dies, you gain one stack for each ally or skill that contributed to the kill, each giving +3% Weapon Damage and +3% Critical Hit Damage. Maximum 35 stacks; stacks decay every 10 seconds.

talents.name: All for One
talents.text: Increases the number of marks you can place from 4 to 8.

talents.name: One for All
talents.text: Increases the Weapon Damage per Camaraderie stack from 3% to 6%.

notes: Launch values (Ubisoft Y7S3): mark 7 s, Critical Hit Damage 2% per stack, One for All 3% -> 5%. Y8S3: mark 10 s, Critical Hit Damage 3% (AllThings.how PTS). One for All 3% -> 6% is given by Grindout and the current Fandom page; the Steam guide (April) still shows 5%.
Date: Division Dispatch gives 2025-12-02; Ubisoft's article is dated 2025-12-01.

name: Core Strength

talents.name: Core Exercise
talents.text: For each Core attribute (red, blue, yellow), you also receive 40% of the bonuses of the other two Core attributes. Skill Tiers count as 15% Skill Efficiency when applied this way. All pieces except the backpack roll random Core attributes.

talents.name: Inner Core
talents.text: Increases the share of the other Core attributes' bonuses you receive from 40% to 75%.

talents.name: Outer Core
talents.text: The backpack carries all three Core attributes.

notes: Resolved: 2pc is +10% Weapon Handling (Ubisoft Rise Up article, Grindout, ProtoTrack, Fandom); the Steam guide's Weapon Damage is outdated.
Date: Rise Up went live 2026-04-02 (update 2.24); Ubisoft's article is dated 2026-04-01. Ubisoft's Rise Up article lists Core Strength as the season's gear set.

name: Ortiz: Reficere

talents.name: Ortiz Rapid Application Nanite Prototype
talents.text: Healing skills have their duration and range reduced by 90% but their healing efficiency increased by 150%. When you heal an ally with a skill, that ally gains 30% Hazard Protection for 10 seconds (10 second cooldown per ally).

talents.name: Overcharged Nanites
talents.text: Increases the healing efficiency bonus from 150% to 225%.

talents.name: Improved Dampeners
talents.text: Reduces the duration and range penalty from 90% to 25%.

notes: Live values -90% / +150% (Grindout, Skycoach, KeenGamer launch guide); the Into the Dark PTS notes had -75% / +100%, chest 100% -> 150%, backpack 75% -> 25%. Chest 150% -> 225% and backpack 90% -> 25% follow the live base values (Grindout).

name: Ember Engine

talents.name: Spontaneous Combustion
talents.text: Every status effect you apply has a 40% chance to also apply Burn. If the original status effect was Burn, the enemy takes +25% Burn Damage for the duration of that Burn.

talents.name: Flashpoint
talents.text: Increases the Spontaneous Combustion Burn chance from 40% to 60%.

talents.name: White Hot
talents.text: Increases the duration of the Spontaneous Combustion Burn Damage debuff by 50%.

notes: Resolved: live values are 40% / 60% (Ubisoft Red Horizon launch article, MP1st patch 2.34, KeenGamer, Ubisoft PTS developer notes: chance raised from 20% to 40% and Flashpoint from 40% to 60% between the first PTS and release). The Ubisoft PTS notes (20% / 40%) and Grindout's table (20% base) are outdated.
AllThings.how's 15% Skill Efficiency at 2pc is wrong: Ubisoft, MP1st, KeenGamer, Grindout, ProtoTrack give 8%.
PvP values (not used): 8% chance, Flashpoint 12%, White Hot +12%.
Date: Ubisoft's announcement is dated 2026-08-26; patch 2.34 was deployed 2026-08-27 (MP1st, KeenGamer).
